verdict.rationale: Lium documents pod-level termination triggers: a CLI `--ttl` that auto-removes the pod, and at pod creation a choice of Hours, End time or a USD spend cap after which the pod is deleted. It also offers server-enforced daily, monthly and lifetime USD budgets per API key, so a forgotten instance cannot keep billing. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the timers and spend caps fire reliably (all evidence is vendor docs).

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can set auto-shutdown timers or spend limits so a forgotten instance can't silently run up a huge bill

citations.quote: Pick one, and the pod is deleted when it is reached: Hours... End time... Spend cap: a budget in USD
API keys with scopes and per-key daily, monthly and lifetime USD budgets enforced by the server
